column1: # Korean numerals (N5-55, N5-56). native: the counting word; adn: its form before a counter; sino: Sino-Korean.
# A counter's num feature (lexicon) picks native or sino; native numerals stop at 99, higher numbers are Sino-Korean.
# Rows: value N native adn sino; digit KANJI N; unit KANJI N (十 百 千); alone COUNTER N: the counter is dropped and
# the counting word stands alone (一つ → 하나); predicate KO: the ending of a Korean predicate lemma (a noun sense
# with it reads as a predicate).
